$comment: Completion bar for #36: size Ollama's num_ctx from the prompt (so long chats don't silently truncate the grounding rules), send think:false so qwen3 answers instead of burning the timeout in <think> reasoning, cap history by characters, and stream /api/generate (NDJSON) so reasoning `thinking` chunks never leak and slow generations aren't cut off. estimateNumCtx is pure (floored at 2048, capped at 8192); readOllamaStream accumulates `response` only; stripThinking also drops a mid-answer unclosed <think>.
